crossRefs.note: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of…
He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

people.name: Amaziah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Joash

people.name: Salt_Valley
people.line: Valley where David and his commanders defeated enemies

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.
translations.bsb: Amaziah, however, summoned his strength and led his troops to the Valley of Salt, where he struck down 10,000 men of Seir,
translations.kjv: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
translations.asv: And Amaziah took courage, and led forth his people, and went to the Valley of Salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
